description.zh:
边缘实例ID。在物联网平台控制台的**边缘计算** > **边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The edge instance ID. In the IoT Platform console, go to **Edge Computing** > **Edge Instances**, and hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance to view its ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain it.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Pass it for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用[QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~)接口获取场景联动规则ID。
description.en: The scene orchestration rule ID. Call the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) API to obtain the rule ID.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
